title: Lucky Dog Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutLucky Dog ~ 142 Savelle Drive ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Lucky Dog is an exceptional family friendly,1,998sf home located in the private, Gulf Trace neighborhood. With an additional 2,800 sf of outdoor living, Lucky Dog borders the Grayton Beach State Park and has a private heated pool (heating fee applies), private neighborhood beach access within a 2-minute stroll, 4 bedrooms/4 baths, and sleeps up to 10. Being surrounded by the Grayton Beach State Park gives Gulf Trace guests ONE FULL MILE of beautiful, undisturbed beaches to enjoy; 2 private neighborhood beach accesses. PLEASE NOTE - Golf carts and on-street parking are STRICTLY PROHIBITED in the Gulf Trace neighborhood, per neighborhood covenants. Lucky Dog borders the Grayton Beach State Park, named America’s #1 Beach in 2020 by Dr. Stephen Leatherman, aka Dr. Beach! “This beach boasts of its sugar-white sand and emerald green water where development has been restrained so big sand dunes still dominate the landscape. At the same time, all the amenities of great restaurants and accommodations are close by in the old town of Grayton Beach or Seaside," wrote Leatherman. Originally named the country’s top beach in 1994, Grayton Beach State Park has been listed FOUR times since 1991, finishing 6th in 2016 and 3rd in 2019. Ground Level: Spacious carport for 2 cars, ping pong table, private heated pool (heating fee applies). Main/2nd Level: Open living area. Dining table seats 8, bar seating for 4. Fully equipped kitchen. 2 Bedrooms. 2 Baths. Laundry room. Screened porch. Covered porch. Grayton Beach State Park wooded view. #1 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, tub/shower #2 Bedroom has 2 Bunks (4T). Full bath, with tub/shower Third Level: 2 Bedrooms, 2 Baths. Covered porch. #3 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, tub/shower. Full-size crib/mattress in closet (sheets not provided). #4 Bedroom has a Queen bed Full bath with tub/shower Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Flat Screen Smart TVs, 2 DVD players, game table, board games, books, movies (YouTube TV; streaming services available with guest personal login credentials) Distinctive Features Private heated pool (heating fee applies) 4-minute walk to private neighborhood beach Ping pong table Fire pit Full-size crib (sheets not provided) Borders Grayton Beach State Park Private Gulf front neighborhood surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park and the Gulf Beach Gear Credit Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, Mr. Coffee K-cup + drip coffee maker, electric range, refrigerator with icemaker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer, gas grill, grill utensils. General Features Carport parking for 2 cars, driveway parking for 2 vehicles 2 King beds, 1 Queen bed, 2 Bunks (4 Twins) Ring Doorbell Cam on Front Entrance Door *PLEASE NOTE - The pool heater at Lucky Dog is an electric heater which will not operate should ambient temperatures fall below 55 degrees; therefore, we do not recommend adding pool heating to your stay in colder months. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Downtown Grayton (1.5 mile) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
